title: Driver Value Object and a Pythonic Container
instructions: Implement `Driver` and `DriverPool` in `pool.py`. `Driver` identity is its read-only `driver_id` (used by both `__eq__` and `__hash__`). `DriverPool` keeps the first driver per ID in insertion order and behaves like a built-in collection: `len`, repeatable iteration, indexing, slicing to a new pool, membership by driver or ID, `+` and `repr`. Do not subclass `list`.

evidence.label: Drivers are equal and hash equal by ID; rating changes keep set membership
Driver equality returns NotImplemented for foreign types
driver_id is read-only while name and rating are plain attributes
Driver and DriverPool reprs match the documented format
The pool keeps the first driver per ID in insertion order
Empty pool is falsy via __len__ and iteration is repeatable
Indexing returns a Driver and slicing returns a new DriverPool
Membership works by Driver or by ID string
+ unions pools and rejects other types
The pool copies its input, accepts any iterable and does not subclass list
